description: Section numbers and rule names that the claims table and the positioning caption cite (D-86, D-88). 'checked' is the paper revision the claims were judged against, used by BENCHMARKS.md; 'current' is the paper the tables under paper/ cite, pinned by sha256; the paper is not in the repository (D-90). Update 'current' when that paper changes: with a local docs/paper.pdf, dc-bench paper refuses a map whose current.sha256 is not its. Each entry follows the claim's content, not its old section number. An entry with only 'current' is a section, table or appendix the paper cites where BENCHMARKS.md keeps an internal reference or a test file ({{iref:...}} in the template, or the positioning caption).
